selector.rationale: Takotsubo cardiomyopathy is supported by the presence of systolic apical ballooning on left ventriculography and the absence of coronary artery disease, which aligns with the typical presentation of this condition.

rejected.label: Acute coronary syndrome
rejected.why: Normal coronary arteries on angiography contradict this diagnosis

rejected.label: Acute myocardial infarction
rejected.why: Normal coronary arteries and the pattern of cardiac enzyme elevation do not support this diagnosis

rejected.label: Adrenal carcinoma
rejected.why: While an adrenal mass is present, the primary clinical presentation is cardiac, suggesting the adrenal finding is incidental

rejected.label: Pheochromocytoma-induced cardiomyopathy
rejected.why: While pheochromocytoma could explain some findings, the direct evidence for pheochromocytoma-induced cardiomyopathy is less compelling than for Takotsubo cardiomyopathy
